instagram.caption:
The guy who ran OpenAI’s day-to-day partnerships and operations for years is walking out the door. His name is Brad Lightcap, and he’s leaving to start something new. 🚪

Lightcap was the trusted right hand who closed the deals and kept the machine running. His exit lands exactly as OpenAI’s valuation explodes—so the timing isn’t just a footnote, it’s the story. ⏱️

Whoever steps in will control the partnerships and daily decisions that shape how you access AI tools. If the hire leans safety-first, expect slower rollouts. If it’s a speed demon, expect features shipped half-baked.

You’ll feel this in your content pipeline within a quarter. So: what would you look for in that new COO—reliability or momentum? 🤔
